scenes: Would this heatwave have happened anyway?
Climate attribution answers that. | In 2025, each person lived through thirteen and a half heatwave days on average. | About eleven of them would not have been expected without climate change.
And of the heat deaths in 2023, | the report attributes seventy-one and a half per cent to climate change.
Not bad luck: a cause we can act on.
